objective: Progress towards validated actual flood occurrence across Karnataka; initial observable open-water pilot does not cover all flood mechanisms

recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.unit: Whole fixed 1000m EPSG:32643 grid cells, origin [0,0], within the existing public 3km Udupi window; freeze geometry/hash and observation domain before sampling. Other Karnataka regions need separate geographic/quality validation.
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.issue_time: Exactly 24 hours before T_s, a satellite pass scheduled and archived before issue; no retrospective use of actual sensing time to invent a forecast issue
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.horizon: Temporary open-water inundation present at the scheduled future acquisition approximately24h after issue; not occurrence anywhere throughout the next24h
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.schedule_tolerance: Proposed +/-5minutes; the complete publisher sensing interval must lie within it. Missed/delayed or incomplete observations remain UNKNOWN. This tolerance requires scientific approval.
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.positive_definition: Independently verified temporary, unobstructed open-water patch exceeding3ha with width at least200m inside the fixed unit, over previously non-permanent-water land; thresholds reflect a documented OPERA mapping domain, not established local detection performance
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.negative_definition: An independently validated observation process capable of detecting the defined patch adequately observes the whole fixed unit at that acquisition and verifies its absence. Permanent-water baseline, registration, local omission/commission limits and all quality masks must be reviewed; source class0 alone is insufficient.
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.unknown: Any unresolved permanence, physical event, local detectability, partial coverage, source correction/version, obstructed land, independent reference, timing/schedule, rights or scientific review
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.permanent_water: Retain separately using a contemporary independently reviewed seasonal/permanent-water baseline; historic JRC occurrence alone does not establish 2024-2026 permanence
excluded_until_separately_validated: Patches below the reviewed detection domain
recommended_first_satellite_prediction_t.geography_status: Udupi public research window only; no certified district-wide or statewide coverage

target_comparison.validation: Native product time/grid/classes plus independently verified temporary/permanent/dry evidence and adequate spatial quality at that sensing interval

target_comparison.target: Any temporary inundation during the following24h
target_comparison.validation: A verified timed patch can support an existential positive; negatives require a reviewed process observing the complete unit throughout the complete interval, capable of detecting the target

target_comparison.target: Measured river discharge crosses an independently justified flood threshold during next24h
target_comparison.validation: Verified station/reach, measured timestamped discharge and QC, threshold with physical flood justification in compatible units, adequate within-window sampling, rating curves if converting stage, historically available forecast/reforecast inputs

phase12d_assessment: The 250m/2500m2 next24h protocol remains frozen and unapproved. A 30m product grid does not validate a 0.25ha target; documented OPERA open-water domain >3ha/200m is incompatible with assuming that detection threshold. MODIS event maxima and single SAR passes cannot validate daily absence.
predictor_requirements: Archive original run time, forecast valid interval, publication/availability receipt and version before issue; antecedent observations must end before issue
Do not use target-window satellite classifications or subsequently corrected/reanalysed hydrology as if they were historically available predictors

Suitable reforecasts can support a separately approved retrospective forecast experiment with explicit initialization, forcing cutoff, model/calibration lineage and matching variables/versions. They were generated later and are not historically issued forecasts or evidence of live deployment skill.
GloFAS daily-mean discharge is not a measured flood label or an instantaneous within-window maximum; current v4 reforecast overview must not be silently combined with retained v5 historical output
independent_evaluation: External scientific review binds target, source versions/corrections, unit/time geometry, local detection/permanence evidence and rights before label approval

Adjudicate physical events independently; news reports and repeated pixels are not independent examples. Hold out complete events, later time blocks and separate Karnataka geographic regions; embargo overlapping feature/outcome windows.

Predeclare positive and adequately observed dry sampling across seasons; report excluded/unknown observations and selection bias. Determine sample adequacy by independent power/uncertainty review, not an arbitrary row count.

Evaluate precision/recall, false alarms, missed floods, calibration/Brier score with uncertainty, against climatology and persistence/physically relevant baselines. No current predictive metrics exist.
Keep acquisition classifier accuracy, retrospective reforecast skill, genuine historically issued forecast skill and statewide transfer evidence separate
